Metformin slows down aging and extends life span of female SHR mice.
It is interesting to note that the responsiveness of female SHR mice to the prolongevity effects of metformin was dependent of the age of the animals at the onset of treatment. Of significance, the prolongevity effect of metformin was observed also in a second strain of male mice (hybrid B6C3F1), with a 4.15% increase in mean life span in response to 0.1% metformin supplementation in the diet (Martin-Montalvo et al. 2013).
